Sports · India

India defeats Zimbabwe by 90 runs to win T20 series 2-0

India secured a 2-0 lead in the T20 series against Zimbabwe by winning the second match by 90 runs. Key performances included half-centuries from Kishan and Varma, and contributions from bowlers. This victory provides a boost to new T20I captain Shreyas Iyer, following recent series losses. The win also marks a path to recovery for the team after a streak of defeats.
